title: Some group or people in here disliking all games made with AI
author: Novel-Common9013
selftext:
If you are game developer just do not use Reddit and never listen "AI Slop".

There are very envy group here what I see disliking posts.

comments.author: Substantial_Ad_8651
comments.body: yah I dislike the ai slop, not the good ones, some "games" are just plain trash. in the other hand I have seen games where ppl put effort and it shines

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: As your older brother, I suggest you see a psychiatrist; what you're doing is completely not normal.

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectul to others and follow reddits guidelines and policies.

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: Yes I am, first game maker with "AI Tools" in the world. Problem?

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: You're not and we're all tired of your BS.

comments.author: Soul_Mate_4ever
comments.body: I’ve seen those people here too. The sub is called Ai game dev, and then I’ll see other people post their projects here and get downvoted into oblivion because they made it with Ai. So then, what’s the point of the sub? Most people here are still learning how to build their first game using Ai.

replies.author: GrandPaladin
replies.body: Mostly because of lack of effort and learning, especially when all you need to do to fix issues is fine tuning with more prompts + some more creativity and well thought out plans

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: actually some people just dislike dumb posts, make a game with ai, and show its not slop. these type of posts are pointless

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: I don't personally care what method a person uses to create something, AI or not. I care about the quality and the fun of the output.

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: I am %99.9 sure you were saying "AI Slop" :)

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: Anything can be slop not just ai

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: Get out before I kick your butt

comments.author: ZedIsAPrimeNumber
comments.body: I've been working on a game with AI for weeks now and it's still far from done, almost going at it 24/7 to be sure to get all the mechanics right, and the art cohesive, and it baffles me when people post games here that they made in 0–3 days filled with fatal bugs and zero vision. I've been downvoting some of those too. I guess they're obviously more common than games made with effort.

replies.author: Soul_Mate_4ever
replies.body: Oh gotcha, that makes sense. You’re downvoting the lack of effort it took to make the low quality game.

replies.author: ZedIsAPrimeNumber
replies.body: Yeah. Some are browser games made in one shot and sometimes the posts are likely longer than the original prompt. Worse, they ask for feedback when the thing was barely tested or doesn't even work.
